To convert a temperature from Fahrenheit (°F) to Celsius (°C), use the formula:

$$
°C = \frac{5}{9} (°F - 32)
$$

Substitute 98.6 for °F:

$$
°C = \frac{5}{9} (98.6 - 32)
$$

First, subtract 32 from 98.6:

$$
98.6 - 32 = 66.6
$$

Now multiply by $\frac{5}{9}$:

$$
°C = \frac{5}{9} \times 66.6 = \frac{5 \times 66.6}{9} = \frac{333}{9} = 37
$$

Thus, 98.6°F is equal to 37°C. This is the standard value for normal human body
